sprint_data.audio_transcript:
[SCENE START]
[Sound of projector fan and low chatter]
Coordinator: Morning team. We are finalising the Anti-Scam Campaign before the district launch next Monday. Please update your briefing sheets now.
Coordinator: First, our emergency referral protocol. If a citizen reports an active transfer, we do not tell them to wait. We instruct them to call the Anti-Deception Coordination Centre hotline immediately: 18222. Repeat that with me once: one-eight-two-two-two.
Coordinator: Second, deployment numbers. We had planned 12 street booths, but Operations approved two extra booths for Yau Tsim Mong, so the total is now 14 booths citywide. Peak-time staffing remains four volunteers per booth.
Coordinator: Third, digital support. The WhatsApp alert channel pilot begins on 18 June, not 16 June. Please correct that date in your handout.
Coordinator: Training schedule now. Session A runs from 9:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Session B runs from 2:15 p.m. to 3:45 p.m. Each session can take 24 trainees, and we currently have 38 confirmed. That means we still have 10 seats left.
Coordinator: Materials checklist. Every booth must display three items: the red fraud-warning banner, the QR code stand for e-reporting, and the bilingual card that lists warning signs. The old yellow banner is discontinued.
Coordinator: Last point: escalation language. If callers mention romance-investment scams, label the case as Priority R within the first two minutes so police liaison can fast-track it.
Coordinator: Good. I need final attendance names by 5:30 p.m. today. Thanks everyone.
[SCENE END]

questions.question: Which banner is currently required at each booth?
How should romance-investment scam cases be tagged?

integrated_data.audio_transcript:
[INTEGRATED BRIEFING START]
Host: Thank you all for joining this cross-agency planning meeting on anti-scam outreach. We have one week before launch.
Police Liaison Officer: Reported losses rose by 17% quarter-on-quarter in two elderly-dense districts. We need faster referral language at first contact.
NGO Director: Our concern is message clarity. Seniors remember examples better than statistics, so every workshop should include one short role-play.
Bank Risk Manager: We can provide branch volunteers for lunchtime booths, but only on weekdays. Weekends will require school-based volunteers.
Education Bureau Rep: Student ambassadors are available, but schools requested a capped duty length. Maximum booth duty per student should be two hours.
Host: Noted. We also need stronger multilingual support. Current handouts are Chinese-English only; Urdu and Nepali one-page inserts can be ready by Friday.
Police Liaison Officer: One correction: hotline wait-time target is not three minutes. The official KPI remains under five minutes average during campaign hours.
Host: Good catch. For media, Radio segment goes live next Tuesday at 8:10 a.m. Social clips should go out the evening before.
NGO Director: We should define one measurable outcome per channel. For workshops, use post-session confidence score. For booths, use number of successful suspicious-transfer interruptions.
Host: Final action owner list will be circulated tonight.
[INTEGRATED BRIEFING END]

data_file.title: Internal Email: Campaign Scope
data_file.content:
From: Strategy Unit
To: District Teams
Subject: Final campaign scope
- Priority districts: Yau Tsim Mong, Sham Shui Po
- Core channels: Street booths, school talks, radio reminders
- Mandatory booth items: red banner, QR stand, bilingual warning card
- Submission deadline for district staffing list: Friday 5:30 p.m.

STOP. THINK. VERIFY.
If transfer is in progress, call ADCC Hotline 18222 immediately.
Never share one-time passwords.
Need help reporting? Scan the official e-report QR code.

writing_task.instruction: You are the Student Outreach Lead. Write a formal memo to all district volunteer captains summarizing the final launch plan, clarifying corrected details, and assigning immediate follow-up actions.

marking_key: State campaign urgency using the reported increase in scam losses.
Confirm hotline number 18222 and referral purpose.
Include updated logistics: 14 booths and 4 volunteers per booth at peak.
Clarify timing corrections (WhatsApp pilot date; hotline wait-time KPI under five minutes).
Assign stakeholder-specific actions (schools, banks, NGOs, district teams).
Define measurable outcomes/KPIs for at least two channels.
